title: Identity conflicts
invariant: one Soundcharts UUID per artist; metrics only for resolved identities

probes.name: duplicate-uuid
probes.message: one Soundcharts UUID resolved for multiple artists
probes.sql: SELECT soundcharts_artist_uuid, count(*) AS artists FROM artist_external_identities WHERE soundcharts_artist_uuid <> '' GROUP BY soundcharts_artist_uuid HAVING count(*) > 1

probes.name: status-uuid-mismatch
probes.message: identity status inconsistent with stored UUID
probes.sql: SELECT artist_id, resolution_status FROM artist_external_identities WHERE (resolution_status = 'resolved' AND soundcharts_artist_uuid = '') OR (resolution_status IN ('unresolved', 'needs_review') AND soundcharts_artist_uuid <> '')

probes.name: metrics-without-identity
probes.message: Soundcharts metrics published for artists without a resolved identity
probes.sql: SELECT m.artist_id, m.platform FROM artist_metrics m LEFT JOIN artist_external_identities i ON i.artist_id = m.artist_id WHERE m.source = 'soundcharts' AND (i.artist_id IS NULL OR i.resolution_status <> 'resolved')

probes.name: orphan-metric-cache
probes.message: metric cache rows for artists that no longer exist
probes.sql: SELECT c.entity_id, c.platform FROM integration_metric_cache c WHERE c.entity_type = 'artist' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM artists a WHERE a.id::text = c.entity_id)

probes.name: lander-metrics-without-identity
probes.message: Home social metrics cached without a Lander Records identity
probes.sql: SELECT c.platform FROM integration_metric_cache c JOIN lander_records_integration_settings s ON s.key = 'lander_records' WHERE c.entity_type = 'lander_records' AND c.source = 'soundcharts' AND s.soundcharts_artist_uuid = ''
